Due to the UTK Football Game, Route 42 will be on a detour beginning at approximately 9:00 am. 

Outbound from Church Ave, turn left on Locust Street, turn right on Cumberland Ave, then turn left on Hwy 129 to rejoin the regular route. 

Inbound from Alcoa Hwy, exit to Kingston Pike/Cumberland, right onto Cumberland Ave into Main Street, left on State Street, right on Church to Knoxville Station.

If the Alcoa Hwy ramp is closed, an alternative route of I40E will be taken.

Please be mindful of additional delays, as there will be increased congestion and possible road closures.
